lines.text: &fLetters from the server staff: news, apologies, gifts.
&7Unread letters have a &6●&7. The hub button in your inventory shows a dot while any are waiting.
&7The whole letter is always shown, including what is attached.
&7Press &aAccept&7 to take what is attached: money goes to your balance, items to your inventory (dropped at your feet if it is full).
&7Each letter can be accepted once. Letters disappear when they expire.
